script.title: FOREST-79 — The Ewok Orbital Village
script.description: Classic 1978 Space meets an Ewok treetop village: blue log-built observation huts, yellow glazing, timber docking decks, a rope bridge, forest radar and a wooden-spar star glider. Three Ewok astronauts operate the outpost.
